title: Decisions where either condition is enough
objective: Use OR inside IF so that a decision is made when at least one condition is true.
instructions: In E2:E7 show "Include" when the region is "Nairobi" OR weekly sales are above the big-sales threshold in B9; otherwise show "Skip". In F2:F7 show "Support" when weekly sales are below the low-sales threshold in B10 OR sell-through is below the floor in B11; otherwise show "OK".
hints: OR(test1, test2) is TRUE when at least one test is TRUE. Put it inside IF as the condition.
Text in a test needs double quotes: B2="Nairobi". For E2: =IF(OR(B2="Nairobi",C2>$B$9),"Include","Skip").
For F2 use the low-sales and floor cells: =IF(OR(C2<$B$10,D2<$B$11),"Support","OK"). Use the dollar locks so the formula copies down.
